headline: White House Aide Discloses Secret Recording System in Oval Office
dispatch: Senate investigators revealed yesterday that the White House had secretly recorded conversations in the Oval Office, a disclosure made by deputy chief of staff Alexander Butterfield under questioning. The taping system, installed without public knowledge, captured discussions between President Nixon and his aides. The revelation immediately transformed the Watergate inquiry, as prosecutors and senators moved to subpoena the recordings.
answer: Secret White House taping system revealed to Senate, 1973
